name: Tyrolean Brandy Tasting & Erber Show Distillery
beschreibung:
### Overview
Tyrolean schnapps distilling represents a centuries-old artisanal craft deeply rooted in mountain heritage. The Erber distillery in Brixen im Thale, nestled in the Kitzbühel Alps, is honored as Tyrol's oldest copper-pot distillery. Its origins date back to the 16th century under Emperor Maximilian I, with the Erber family distilling concession documented since 1651. In the 18th century, Empress Maria Theresa granted select alpine estates hereditary distilling rights that remain tied to individual farmsteads today. A guided tour of this show distillery and its rustic tasting lodge reveals the craft of traditional double distillation: hand-selected fruits, wild berries, and stone pine cones are gently distilled in copper stills, where copper catalyzes unwanted compounds to extract pristine botanical aromatics.

### Route & Requirements
The 75-minute experience commences with an expert-guided walk through the glass-walled production area and copper still house. Guests then enjoy a short feature film in the distillery cinema showcasing the journey from orchard to bottle. The finale is a curated tasting in the Erber Brennhäusl lodge, sampling four premium schnapps varieties and liqueurs guided by a certified sommelier. Highlights include spicy Swiss stone pine spirit (Zirbe), rare wild rowanberry (Vogelbeere), earthy masterwort (Meisterwurz), and crisp Williams pear brandies. Under Section 13 of the Tyrolean Youth Act, alcohol tasting is strictly reserved for guests aged 18 and over; minors and designated drivers are served fresh mountain spring water and regional fruit juices.

### Getting There
Distillery Erber is located at Dorfstraße 57 in the center of Brixen im Thale. Travel by rail is ideal via the Salzburg-Tyrol line to Brixen im Thale station, followed by an easy 6-minute walk (approx. 500 meters) to the venue, allowing visitors to enjoy the tasting without driving concerns. By car, take motorway A12 (exit Wörgl Ost) and federal road B170 in about 15 minutes. Free on-site customer parking is available.

### Tips
Scheduled weekly tours run regularly (such as Thursdays at 10:00 am); groups of five or more should reserve in advance by phone or email. Holders of the regional Kitzbüheler Alpen guest card enjoy discounts on tours and shop purchases. Don't miss tasting the rare Meisterwurz spirit, distilled from alpine root botanicals prized as a digestive. For hygiene reasons, pets are not allowed in production and tasting rooms.
